note:
Cost model of SWRT's S_nl on ecWAM's basis (user 2026-11-03: the cost line is defined by ecWAM's own S_nl routines), as
keydoc/swrt/candidates/ww3cost/scripts/time_sets_ww3.py did on WAVEWATCH III's: the model's own compiled routines SNONLIN (DIA) and
SNONLIN_SWRT (SWRT, every anchor bin, no MIJ truncation) from libecwam_dp of bundle/build_bit (-O2, no -march), called by the
stand-alone driver snl_time (snl_time.F90; set up as INITMDL for ISNONLIN = 0, deep water) on the 15,000 synthetic training spectra
(seeds 11, 1-9) in chunks of NPROMA = 32 points, one thread, both with subnormal results flushed to zero (FTZ, see snl_time.F90).
The sets are those of make_sets_ec.py (quick searches over K = 6-70 and L = 4-40, with their gains, plus the K36/18 operator), each
written as an operator file (ww3/nl6/export_operator.py format) in ops/. Each run is one process: three passes over the spectra, the
shortest counts. Every run is pinned to the same core (taskset -c CPU) and starts only when no ww3_shel and no re-time script of
swrt_speed_local_12h runs and the 1-min load is below 2.5; the load is logged around each run. Rounds alternate the order; DIA is timed before every 8th set and at the end of a
round. The minimum over the rounds is fitted by t = c0 + a K + b L (us per spectrum) -> time_sets_ec.json.
